editorial:
Imagine you are driving across the country to start a new life after a huge loss, only to have a creepy stranger force you off the road. That is exactly what happens to you in this tense ride. You follow a woman who is just trying to heal, but she quickly becomes the target of a cold killer. The vibe is super stressful from the start, making you feel like you are right there in the car or hiding in the woods. It is a simple story, but it works because it focuses on the basic fear of being hunted by someone who just will not stop.

What really makes this work is the acting and the way the movie keeps you on edge. The pacing is great, and the action feels real rather than fake. While it does not have a huge plot twist, the survival parts are exciting. If you love movies where a smart character has to outwit a bad guy, you will love this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: After a long chase through the woods, the woman manages to fight back. She uses her surroundings to trap the killer and eventually stabs him in the neck with a piece of sharp wood. She does not just run away; she makes sure he is dead. The movie ends with her finally escaping the wilderness and finding safety, showing that she has found the strength to survive her trauma and the killer.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers and cat-and-mouse games.
